funds.directEquityBasis: GIC’s official Infrastructure investment group executes direct equity investments in private infrastructure assets with cash-flow visibility and active ownership, including co-investments and platform investments.

northAmericaQualification.rationale: Duke Energy’s 2025 annual report confirms that, as of December 31, 2025, an affiliate of GIC holds a 19.9% minority interest in Duke Energy Indiana, and original transaction materials attribute the investment to GIC’s Infrastructure investment leadership.

snapshot.investmentStrategy: Global direct infrastructure investment program targeting private assets with stable cash flows and inflation linkage across sectors including utilities, energy, transport, and digital infrastructure.

evidence.title: GIC Report on the Management of the Government’s Portfolio 2025/26
evidence.evidenceSummary: Describes GIC’s Infrastructure investment group as investing mainly in private infrastructure assets with cash-flow visibility, across developed and emerging markets, confirming the existence and active status of the program.

evidence.title: Infrastructure – GIC Investment Group
evidence.evidenceSummary: Details GIC’s infrastructure strategy including direct investments in utilities, renewable energy, transport, and digital infrastructure platforms, supporting sector scope and direct-equity classification.

evidence.title: Duke Energy Corporation 2025 Annual Report
evidence.evidenceSummary: Confirms that as of December 31, 2025, an affiliate of GIC owns a 19.9% minority interest in Duke Energy Indiana, evidencing an active United States infrastructure equity holding and supporting North America as an evidenced strategy region for the included program.

funds.repoDispositionRationale: Repository uses non-official naming ('GIC Infrastructure'), includes unsupported sector 'Social Infra' while omitting evidenced sector exposure such as Midstream, and classifies only Global despite verified current North American deployment; updated to align with official program naming, sector evidence, and the evidenced North American holding.

excludedCandidates.rationale: Represents LP commitments to external infrastructure funds rather than direct-equity investments.
Represents infrastructure debt and credit strategies, which are explicitly excluded from the direct-equity census.

notes: Single sovereign infrastructure program; no discrete closed-end fund series identified.
